name: Grapple Rope Effects
description: The Grapple Rope's look and sound on everyone's screen: the Printer it is built from carved into a jungle hook launcher of dark hardwood, bamboo, vine, moss and brass; a three-pronged brass hook that flies out and bites; a braided hemp rope that sags when slack and twangs when it snaps tight; and sounds for throwing, biting, twanging and letting go.
